payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) melts before the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS) due to specific geological processes, such as continental levering and ocean syphoning, which contribute to early sea level rise.

claims.text: The Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) melts first, contributing to an early peak in sea level before the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS) begins to melt.
The melting of GrIS contributes 2 m to sea level rise at 125 ka, while AIS starts melting later at 118 ka, contributing an additional 5 m.
